scientific_integrity: An analytical finite-graph proof and reproducible small-graph checks are supplied; neither exhaustive priority nor independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two unweighted simple cycles with a single shared absorbing vertex; adjacency or combinatorial Laplacian Hamiltonian and fixed positive imaginary sink. General graphs and other detection protocols are not treated.
title: Arithmetic dark-state resonance for a lossy junction of two quantum cycles
